sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Prem Shankar Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1. Supplementary affidavit filed by the applicant and supplementary counter affidavit filed by the informant are taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Raghuvansh Misra, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Prem Shankar, learned counsel for the informant and Sri Ashutosh Singh, learned AGA for the State-respondent.
3.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.
215 of 2022, under Sections 376, 493, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Manda,
District- Prayagraj, during pendency of the trial in the court below.

4. FIR of the present case was lodged on 31.07.2022 against applicant and others and according to FIR, victim was aged about 17 years 10 months and applicant for last 5 years was making physical relationship with her under the false promise of marriage.

It is further mentioned in the FIR that Shivani Seth Yogendra vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66844201/
1 victim i.e. informant of the case is having pregnancy of 3 months' from the applicant and now applicant is denying to perform marriage with her.
5.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that on the basis of false allegation, applicant has been made accused in the present matter along with his family members.

He further submitted that even according to FIR, at the time of lodging the same, victim was aged about 17 years 10 months and, therefore, at the time of FIR she was at the verge of majority and from the FIR and statements of the victim recorded during investigation, it reflects that she was consenting party.
6.

He further submitted that as from the statement of the mother of the victim recorded during investigation, it reflects that earlier marriage of the informant/ victim was performed with some other person, therefore, at this stage it cannot be said that the child, which was delivered by the victim, belongs to the applicant.

He next submits, if after DNA test, it was found that child belongs to the applicant then applicant is ready to bear the responsibility of the child and he is also ready to perform marriage with the victim and in this regard a specific averment has been made by the applicant in the supplementary affidavit dated 09.12.2024.
He further submitted that even for the DNA test of the child, an application has been moved by the informant side on 20.04.2024, which is still pending.

7. He further submitted that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter,
he is in jail since 03.06.2023 i.e. for last more than one and half years.

8. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that as applicant was having relationship with the victim for last five years and at that time, she was minor, therefore, it cannot be said that applicant has not committed any offence.
9. Learned counsel for the informant however, further submitted that victim is also ready to perform marriage with the applicant.

He also conceded that on 20.04.2024 informant has moved an application for DNA test of the child of the informant but her application is still pending and,
therefore, if any direction is given by this Court to the court concerned with regard to disposal of the application dated 20.04.2024 then he is having no objection.
10.
I have heard both the parties and perused the record of the case.

11. However, as per informant, she was 17 years 10 months' old and she conceived with the applicant but considering the age of the victim/informant disclosed in the FIR, at this stage it cannot be said that at the time of lodgment of the FIR, she was not major.
12.
Further, from the FIR and both the statements of the victim recorded during investigation, it reflects that she was consenting party.

13. Record further suggests that after lodgment of the FIR, victim has delivered a child and however,
according to her, applicant is the father of the child but as per applicant, as earlier also marriage of the victim had been solemnized with some other person, therefore, with surety it cannot be said that Shivani Seth Yogendra vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66844201/

sentences.text: the child, which was delivered by the victim, belongs to the applicant, however, through supplementary affidavit, applicant made an averment that if after DNA test, it was found that the child belongs to the applicant then he is ready to perform marriage with the victim and also ready to accept the child.
14. From the record, it also reflects that for DNA examination of the child, an application has been moved by the informant before the court concerned on 20.04.2024, which is still pending.
15. Therefore, considering the above facts and circumstances of the case, in view of this Court, it is a case in which applicant should be enlarged on bail.
16. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

17. Let the applicant- Shivani Seth Yogendra be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
18. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

19. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.

20. However, considering the facts of the case, in the interest of justice, it is directed that trial court shall decide the application dated 20.04.2024 moved by informant for D.N.A. examination in accordance with law at the earliest.
Order Date :- 10.12.2024 KK Patel  Shivani Seth Yogendra vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 10 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66844201/
